title: Model APIs
description: Manage model providers, Secret references, request URLs, and model names. Credential plaintext never enters page state.
createNeedWorkspace: Create or join a Workspace first
modalSubtitle: Configure shared model API gateway settings
verifyBusy: Another model config is being tested
emptyBody: Add a model API config so Workspaces and Agents can select a model gateway.
emptyFilterBody: Switch to all configs to see other model gateways.
providerLockedTitle: Provider is fixed to OpenAI Compatible. Create a new model config to switch providers.
keepExistingCredential: Leave blank to keep current credential
credentialHelpCreate: The key is sent only on submit and encrypted on the server. The page never echoes or keeps plaintext.
credentialHelpEdit: Only the Secret reference is submitted. The server never returns or backfills key plaintext.
createdByLockedTitle: Creator is recorded by server audit fields and cannot be changed by the client.
createdByPending: Recorded by the server after save
runtimeHelp: Tell the platform roughly how much content this model can see at once. If you do not know the vendor limit, choose 128K (recommended) below. Used only for session trim budgets—does not change the model or write upstream Options.
contextWindowHint: Rough limit for history + prompt in one request. Grok / GPT-4o families often start at 128000; try 200000 for very long context.
outputReserveHint: Space reserved for the model’s reply. 4096 is fine for most cases; raise it for very long answers.
tokenizerHint: Used by the platform to estimate content length—not to switch models. Prefer the recommended option; choose the conservative bound if you are unsure.
outputLimitHint: Keep max_tokens for most OpenAI-compatible gateways; change only if upstream docs require it.
smartHintCreate: If context is unclear, pick 128K. After create, choose “Token window” in the Agent; Secret plaintext never enters page state.
smartHintEdit: Leave Secret ID blank to keep the current credential; run a durable verification from the list after save.
syncNote: Changes sync to the model config list immediately
discardBody: This model config draft has unsaved edits. Discarding will not save them.
deleteBody: This will delete “{name}”. This cannot be undone.
verifyPassedFunctionCalling: Verified. On-demand search or carry-all tools are available.
verifyPassedToolLess: Verified. Tool-less chat works. This model cannot be bound to an Agent that has tools.
verifyFailed: {name} verification failed. Check credentials, URL, and model name.
deleteFailed: Delete failed. Check the network or try again later.
saveFailed: Save failed. Check the network or try again later.
validationSecretUuid: Secret ID must be a valid UUID—do not paste an API Key or Token.
validationApiBaseUrl: Enter a valid URL (including http:// or https://).
disclosureHidden: This model supports native tool search and already loads tools on demand. No configuration needed.
disclosureUnavailable: This model cannot call tools and cannot be bound to an Agent that has tools.
disclosureBinaryHelp: Choose how the model sees tools. Saving affects new runs only.
disclosureOnDemand: On-demand search (recommended; load at most 5 tools each time)
disclosureCarryAll: Carry all (only for Agents with 8 tools or fewer)
disclosureSaveFailed: Failed to save the disclosure policy. Check the network or try again later.
